# GitHub repository discovery

These are the proposed public About settings for [Araryarch67/Riflay](https://github.com/Araryarch67/Riflay).
This file documents the settings; GitHub does not apply them automatically.

## Description

```text
Riflay is a free, open-source hi-fi music player for local audio and YouTube Music, with FLAC, synced lyrics and Smart Merge. Built with Flutter.
```

## Topics

Use these 20 topics in the repository's About settings:

```text
riflay
music
music-player
youtube
youtube-music
youtube-music-client
audiophile
hi-fi
lossless-audio
flac
synced-lyrics
smart-merge
cross-platform
flutter
dart
android
windows
linux
macos
ios
```

## Apply and verify

1. Sign in with an account that can edit this repository's settings.
2. Open the repository's main page and select the gear beside **About**.
3. Set the description and topics above. Keep the existing website setting unless there is a verified public project site to add.
4. Save, then verify the About text and topic links on the public repository page.

GitHub's default repository search matches names, descriptions and topics. Searching README content requires
the `in:readme` qualifier. The README's introduction, headings, descriptive screenshot text and useful links
also help visitors and web search engines understand the project. Neither these changes nor topics guarantee
a particular search position.

References: [GitHub repository search](https://docs.github.com/en/search-github/searching-on-github/searching-for-repositories),
[GitHub topics](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/classifying-your-repository-with-topics),
[Google Search Essentials](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/essentials).
